pick.headline: Lebanon's President-elect Bashir Gemayel assassinated
pick.fbis: The Middle East review in the Daily Report of September 15, 1982, led with Beirut radio's announcement that President-elect Bashir al-Jumayyil had been killed by a bomb at Phalangist headquarters in al-Ashrafiyah, after first reports that he had emerged safely, and the IDF moving into West Beirut.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 179, 15 September 1982
evidence.snippet: DAILY REPORT MIDDLE EAST ABD SOUTE ASTA REVIEW 15 SEPTEMBER 1982 Lebanon Death of Al-Jumayyil -- President-elect Bashir al-Jumayyil was killed by a bomb explosion in the Phalangist Party headquarters in Al-Ashrafiyah, east Beirut, according to a Lebanese Government announcement braadcast by Beirut radio. alternates.headline: Rev. Benjamin Weir freed in Lebanon
alternates.fbis: The Daily Report of September 16, 1985, (South Asia volume) noted in its regional review that Radio Monte Carlo reported an Islamic Jihad spokesman announcing the release of Benjamin Weir, one of seven Americans kidnapped in Beirut.
